faqs.q: How accurate is Hireon's AI candidate matching?
faqs.a: Hireon's AI delivers approximately 90% precision in role-specific candidate matching across more than 500 job categories. Its recommendations continuously improve as your team provides feedback and hiring outcomes.

faqs.q: Can I import my existing candidate database?
faqs.a: Yes. You can easily import candidates by uploading a CSV file or pasting LinkedIn profile URLs. Hireon automatically parses, enriches, and organizes the data for you.

faqs.q: How does Hireon ensure data security?
faqs.a: Security is a top priority. All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Hireon is SOC 2 Type II compliant, ensuring your recruitment data is protected with industry-standard security practices.

faqs.q: Can I try Hireon before purchasing a paid plan?
faqs.a: Yes. The Starter plan is free forever, allowing you to explore core features at no cost. Growth and Enterprise plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
